# Build web applications & APIs in R. {.hero-title}

::: {.hero-lead}
Ambiorix is an unopinionated, minimalist web framework inspired by
express.js.
:::

:::

::: {.hero-install}

```r
install.packages("ambiorix")
```

:::

::: {.hero-code}

```r
library(ambiorix)

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

app$get("/", function(req, res) {
  res$send("Hello, World!")
})

app$start()
```

## What is Ambiorix? {.section-title}
:::

::: {.section-head-aside}
A framework for serving R over HTTP: multipage applications, JSON APIs,
or anything else you can answer a request with.
:::

:::

::: {.capability-list}

- **Routing**: handlers for HTTP requests (`GET`, `POST`, etc.), with path parameters and
  query strings parsed for you.
- **Responses**: send HTML, plain text, JSON, CSV, files, images,
  and many more formats.
- **Middleware**: run code on every request before it reaches a handler.
- **Templating**: server-side rendering with HTML and markdown built in,
  or register a pug or jade engine.
- **Static files**: serve a whole directory of assets with a single call.
- **Websockets**: bi-directional messaging between the server and the
  client.
- **Async**: return a promise from a handler and the server keeps
  answering everyone else.
- **Routers**: mount sub-applications under a prefix so a large app can
  span many files.

:::

[Read the docs](/docs/){.arrow-link}

:::

## More than hello, world. {.section-title}
:::

::: {.section-head-aside}
Middleware, static files, path parameters and a JSON endpoint.
:::

:::

::: {.showpiece}

```r
library(ambiorix)

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

# middleware runs on every request
app$use(function(req, res) {
  req$received_at <- Sys.time()
})

# serves index.html from the same directory
app$get("/", function(req, res) {
  res$send_file("index.html")
})

# path parameters
app$get("/users/:id", function(req, res) {
  res$json(list(id = req$params$id))
})

# POST with a JSON body
app$post("/users", function(req, res) {
  body <- parse_json(req)
  res$json(list(created = body))
})

app$start()
```

:::

::: {.showpiece-note}
Save it as `app.R` and run `Rscript app.R`.
:::

:::

## The ecosystem. {.section-title}
:::

::: {.section-head-aside}
Published alongside the framework, and entirely optional.
:::

:::

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature}
### Middlewares
Eleven packages you can drop in: logging, sessions, cookies, CSRF
protection, security headers, Prometheus metrics, minification, favicons,
pattern matching, and the pug and jade engines.
:::

::: {.feature}
### Scaffolding
Start from a structured project rather than an empty file. The generator
package builds one from R; the CLI builds the same thing from the
terminal.
:::

::: {.feature}
### Belgic
A reverse proxy and load balancer for putting an application in front of
traffic, spreading requests across several backends.
:::

:::
